settings.date_policy: latest provider close minus five calendar years; 300 prior trading rows reserved as warm-up

fundamentals.input_semantics: Itoflow load_fundamentals_history available_date with publication_lag_days=1; derived PE/ROE/margins; no current screener snapshot backfill
fundamentals.unavailable_reason: Skipped: this request targets ETF/price symbols; stock-only dated value and quality signals are not applied to ETF fundamentals.

benchmark: MSFT.US:buy_hold and VOO.US:buy_hold (when present) use Itoflow provider Close (adjusted series; raw_close retained in OHLCV artifacts) with the same commission and date window.

common_benchmark_calendar.price_treatment: Itoflow provider adjusted Close for benchmark/strategy accounting; raw_close retained in OHLCV artifacts; dividends are reflected only insofar as the provider adjusted series reflects them.

fundamental_decision_dates: First available trading date of each calendar month; scores use only fundamentals with available_date strictly before each date.
news: Not used; this suite is independent of the unavailable GDELT feed.
